prerequisites: Complete Learning C through arrays, structures, pointers and separate source files. Learn the difference between an editor and a compiler before starting the practical project.
nextTopics: New shared services, documentation, SDK consumers and application integration.
seriesPrerequisites: Complete Learning C, then the First application module. The feature-map lesson is a consolidation exercise.

modules.title: First application: one example from source to a window
modules.description: After Learning C, follow the exercise counter through its Framework interface, build description, console and GTK4 window. The C introduction is a recap, not a replacement for the C course.

modules.title: Build, test and investigate a change
modules.description: Use the same project to learn incremental builds, diagnostics and test commands. Continue with test data and skipped coverage after understanding a normal run.

modules.title: Shared services and application lifetimes
modules.description: Further source studies after the first application. Follow registration and inspection before asynchronous work, waiting and connection boundaries.

modules.title: Project study: an offline learning reader
modules.description: A separate project after shared services. Start with the reader and safe example copying, then add help, checkpoints, text and images in that order.

modules.title: Project study: application workspaces
modules.description: After GTK4 events and shared services, study projects, panels, keyboard focus and retained work.

modules.title: Optional application study: calendar data
modules.description: A trading-data example after the core development route; it is not a prerequisite for C or GTK4.

modules.title: Consolidation: map a shared feature
modules.description: Trace the same example through its public contract, implementation, consumers and checks.

modules.title: Practical contracts and memory
modules.description: Apply the preceding ideas to small, source-backed examples. Read the setup recap before each lab.

modules.title: Project: one C model across platforms
modules.description: Follow the shared model through desktop, browser, mobile and sampled-device inputs. Each adapter has its own build and evidence boundary.

modules.title: Project: a microdevice client
modules.description: Cross-compile the shared C model, sample a button and record the actual device observation.

modules.title: Project: SDK hashing and record identity
modules.description: Call the installed SDK, count bytes and capacities, then define an ordered serialization and retained chain head.

modules.title: AI foundations: byte tokens
modules.description: Use the actual Framework tokenizer to preserve arbitrary bytes and validate complete token sequences.

modules.title: AI foundations: dataset partitions
modules.description: Separate training from evaluation, follow seeded shuffling and document its limitations.

modules.title: AI foundations: gradient measurement
modules.description: Measure one global norm across arrays and derive a shared clipping scale without altering inputs.

modules.title: Project: a Framework AI client
modules.description: Compile two original Framework services with a small consumer and exercise their failure contracts.

modules.title: Choose and connect a functionality lab
modules.description: Locate a complete example, identify its shared Framework service and decide which source and result to inspect before extending it.

modules.title: Build language-aware document tools
modules.description: Use the shared document catalogue, inspect language identities, handle borrowed data, validate bounded patterns and trace file-opening behaviour through an application.

modules.title: Observe files and qualify evidence
modules.description: Capture selected bytes through Framework, preserve ownership and storage boundaries, and distinguish byte identity from runtime and test evidence.

modules.title: Restart an owned program
modules.description: Follow asynchronous cancellation, result handover, current authority, transcript preservation and native integration through a shared C23 service.

modules.title: Execute a reviewed development lifecycle
modules.description: Validate complete requests, share one canonical plan, adapt existing services and report partial progress without overstating execution.

modules.title: Deployment state and evidence
modules.description: Rehearse the actual Framework plan and controller, including bounded admission, content-specific approval, cancellation, rollback and revision limits.

modules.title: Task admission and ownership
modules.description: Build safe task descriptors, publish owned values and distinguish local validation from graph and execution evidence.

modules.title: Dependency graph transactions
modules.description: Preserve running workflows during rejected replacements, model dependency policy and qualify graph observations independently of process execution.

modules.title: Task operation ownership
modules.description: Select dependency-closed plans, bound traversal memory and coordinate parallel lifecycle changes through one shared owner.
